product_overview: Storm44 is a free, AI-powered study workspace that transforms user-provided materials like YouTube links, PDFs, and notes into organized notes, flashcards, quizzes, and a mini learning game, complemented by an AI Tutor chat with traceable citations connecting back to the original sources.
core_goals: Convert user materials into an interactive 3-panel workspace with Sources, Chat, and Study Tools.
Deliver chat responses with clickable citations that enable users to verify claims by opening relevant source excerpts.
Generate study aids including flashcards, MCQ quizzes, and a mini-game from selected sources.
Maintain UI responsiveness and smooth performance even with long chat histories and many sources through virtualization and lazy loading.
key_features: 3-panel workspace layout with a left Sources panel, central Chat panel, and right Study Tools panel (flashcards, quizzes, mini-game) that are resizable on desktop and adaptive on mobile/tablet.
Sources panel supporting PDF, TXT, URL, and notes with listing, search, multi-select for chat scope, preview, rename, and delete capabilities.
Chat panel with message thread, streaming AI assistant responses, and citations rendered as clickable links opening corresponding source excerpts with highlights.

Study Tools panel containing tabs for Flashcards, Quizzes, and a Mini-game; flashcards support generation, editing, study mode with grading, and session summaries; quizzes provide MCQ generation with configurable questions and difficulty plus results with explanations and citations; mini-game offers term-definition matching with scoring and replay.
Add Source modal replacing the traditional menu with tabs to upload files, add URLs, or create manual notes, including validation and interactive feedback.
Adaptive UI behaviors including collapsible panels and drawers on smaller screens, drag handle resizing with persistence, and fullscreen toggle for Study Tools panel.
Accessibility features with keyboard operability, focus management, ARIA roles, and modal focus trapping.
Performance optimizations through virtualization, lazy loading, and efficient state management for smooth experience.
Error monitoring, analytics tracking key events like source addition, chat message sending, and study tool usage.
user_flow_summary: User adds sources via the Add Source modal by uploading files, entering URLs, or creating notes; sources appear in the Sources panel list.
User selects multiple sources to define an active scope that filters the content accessible to the AI chat assistant.
User interacts with the chat panel to ask questions and receive streaming responses from the AI Tutor, with citations linking back to source excerpts which open on click.
User navigates to the Study Tools panel and switches between tabs to generate and study flashcards, take quizzes, or play the mini-game, all based on the selected sources.
Users resize panels on desktop or use drawer toggles on mobile to adapt the workspace layout to their preferences, with settings persisting across sessions.
Users can enter Study Tools fullscreen mode which overlays the study tools over other panels and can exit back to the previous layout preserving states.
validation_criteria: Chat responses include clickable citations that open the correct source and highlight the relevant excerpt with best effort.
Sources list supports large numbers of entries with search, virtualization, multi-selection, and preview without UI freezes.
Study Tools can generate flashcards and MCQ quizzes from selected sources, allow edits, support study modes, and show session results accurately.
Mini-game runs smoothly with proper scoring, replay, and integration of selected sources as content.
UI resizing persists correctly across sessions and adapts responsively on mobile devices with drawer behavior.
Add Source modal properly validates inputs, handles uploads, URL addition, note creation, and displays progress and errors as specified.
Accessibility standards met via keyboard navigation, focus traps in modals, ARIA roles, and ESC key handling for dismissing dialogs.
Performance targets met including time to first answer under 2 minutes and smooth experience with hundreds of chat messages and sources.
Analytics events for key interactions such as source_added, chat_sent, flashcards_generated, quiz_completed, and game_completed are correctly captured and reported.
Security measures validate and sanitize inputs and rendered source content to prevent vulnerabilities.
